brief:
As winter weather approaches Gaza, residents face mounting fears about shelter and survival after more than three years of conflict that has devastated the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The onset of rain has intensified concerns among Palestinians already displaced and living in harsh conditions across the enclave.

The humanitarian situation has been compounded by widespread destruction of homes and infrastructure, leaving many without adequate protection from the elements as temperatures drop.

title: Winter poses new survival crisis for Gaza's displaced population
